profiles.abrasion: Recommended nozzle material Yes. As with all carbon-fiber-reinforced materials, the abrasive content will gradually wear down a standard brass nozzle. We recommend a hardened nozzle (e.g., hardened steel or ruby) with a diameter of at least 0.6mm for smooth, reliable extrusion and consistent nozzle lifespan.
